newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine March inflation below target - Centbank.
newsitem.headline: Philippine March inflation below target - Centbank.

text.p: Philippine Central Bank Governor Gabriel Singson said on Friday the year-on-year 4.8 percent inflation figure in March was below the government's expectation of a 5.8 percent rate for the month.
"The March inflation rate sustained its overperformance by one percentage point from the government's programme of 5.8 percent," Singson said in a statement.
The Central Bank chief added he was confident that the government's inflation target of six to seven percent this year will be easily achieved. Inflation was 8.4 percent for the whole of last year.
Earlier, the National Statistics Office reported year-on-year inflation accelerated to 4.8 percent in March from 4.4 in February.
The March inflation figure was higher than the 4.6 percent expected by six securities firms and banks polled by Reuters earlier this week.
Singson also said monetary authorities made sure that targets of base and reserve money were kept substantially below programmed ceilings.
In March, base money and reserve money were 10 billion pesos below their targets, he said.
